_comment: The Deep Research environment: read-only search over a frozen corpus, plus the terminal answer action. All three are `read` because the corpus is immutable and offline, so `ApprovalPolicy` auto-approves them and a rollout never stops for a human. Gated by HARNESS_CORPUS_ENABLED, which is false by default — without the gate these would appear in the `standard` preset (tools: ["*"]) and the production site's agent would silently gain them.

tools.name: corpus_search
tools.description: 在冻结的语料中做关键词检索，返回候选条目的编号、标题和正文开头。检索按词匹配；换一种说法重试往往比重复同一句更有用。

query.description: 检索关键词。用描述内容的实词，不要整句照抄问题。

tools.name: corpus_open
tools.description: 按编号打开一个条目，返回它的标题、正文全文与附带的结构化信息。编号来自 corpus_search 的结果。

doc_id.description: 条目编号，来自 corpus_search 的结果

tools.name: corpus_answer
tools.description: 提交最终答案并结束本轮。answer 只写答案本身，不要写推理过程；答案要尽量短（一个名字、一个年份、yes/no）。citations 必须列出你据以得出答案的条目编号，且必须是你此前真的检索或打开过的。调用后本轮立即结束。

citations.description: 支撑该答案的条目编号列表
